# Pull Request

## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change and why? Reference issues: "Closes #123" -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor / internal cleanup
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build / CI / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test:unit` passes (and `pnpm test:conformance` when schema/validation/renderers are touched)
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` passes when rendering behavior changed
- [ ] Added/updated tests for the change
- [ ] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) for user-facing changes
- [ ] Updated documentation (`docs-site/` / README) when the public API changed
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per the DCO
